Late-night host Jimmy Kimmel has defended a joke in which he called Melania Trump an "expectant widow" just days before a shooting incident at the White House Correspondents' Dinner.

The latest controversy involving Jimmy Kimmel has sparked a wider debate about comedy, politics, and timing. The late-night host found himself at the center of backlash after a joke about Melania Trump during the White House Correspondents’ Dinner. The moment quickly gained attention online, especially after a real-life security incident that followed three days later involving President Donald Trump.

It's a line that some viewers saw as a typical late-night jab, while others viewed it as crossing a line. The situation escalated when the joke resurfaced after a shooting incident at the Correspondents’ Dinner, leading to strong reactions from both Melania Trump and Donald Trump.
